description: Read only the parts of large files a question needs: chunks files or folders along their structure, ranks the chunks against `query` and returns the best that fit `max_tokens`, each with an id and line range. No query: an outline; pick with `ids`. Use instead of reading a big doc, log or folder whole when not editing it. Text, code, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, ODT.

ids.description: Chunk ids from an outline or result, e.g. docs/guide.md#4

model.description: Model the budget is counted for (default Claude)

paths.description: Files or folders, absolute paths; over HTTP pass `text`

query.description: The question; omit for an outline

semantic.description: Also rank by meaning (local Ollama embeddings)

text.description: Raw text to pack instead of files

name: pack_context
